purpose: Customer-side inputs for scripts/generate_corpus.py. Read scenarios/README.md before editing.
blindness_rule: No file in this directory may name, paraphrase or hint at a tool, a schema or an agent capability. These texts describe a person and their problem in the words that person would use. The label comes from what Gemini chose when the real agent ran (DESIGN.md 3.3).
